llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注全髋置换术后血清金属离子浓度，未涉及任何生物力学或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, does not report micromotion, and does not involve any finite element modeling or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 确定全髋置换术后不同摩擦界面的正常金属离子水平。
summary_zh.method: 对四种摩擦界面患者进行血清金属离子分析。
summary_zh.result: 给出了不同界面的离子浓度参考范围。

summary_en.motivation: To establish reference ranges for serum metal ion levels in patients with different bearing surfaces after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Serologic analysis of cobalt, chromium, and titanium ions was performed on patients with four bearing surface types.
summary_en.result: Metal ion concentrations differed across bearing surfaces, with some exceeding suggested thresholds.
summary_en.validation: Clinical serum samples from a cohort of hip arthroplasty patients.
